backgroundOptions: background = a file in _assets/music/ without ".mp3" (every bed there is at -18 LUFS), or none. backgroundLevel = how many dB it sits under the voice while it speaks (it rises 4 dB in the pauses); 15 from EP004 on (the owner: 5 dB louder, 3 Nov 2026; 20 for EP002–EP003), and an episode.json can set its own (EP001: 25, EP002–EP003: 20). Compare beds with: npm run render -- EP00N --audio --background=<name>
sfxNote: Sound effects: "foley" = _assets/sfx-foley/ (cards, paper, books, wood and coins from Kenney's CC0 packs, 06-tools/sfx_foley.py; the owner asked for new sounds on 4 Nov 2026), "synth" = _assets/sfx/ (scripts/music.mjs). EP001–EP003 keep "synth" in their episode.json.
episodeLabelNote: Shown on screen before the episode number ("الملف 01"), from framework v3 §3.9. Change it here only.
